## Copper Dragon, Great Wyrm (CR 20)

**XP** 307,200  
CG Gargantuan dragon (earth)  
**Init** +3; **Senses** dragon senses; Perception +37; **Aura** frightful presence (360 ft., DC 30), slow (10 ft., DC 31, 1d4 rounds)  


**Defense**


**AC** 42, touch 5, flat-footed 42 (-1 Dex, +37 natural, -4 size)  
**hp** 567 (27d12+243)  
**Fort** +23, **Ref** +16, **Will** +22  
**Defensive Abilities** uncanny dodge; **DR** 20/magic; **Immune** acid, paralysis, sleep; **SR** 31  


**Offense**


**Speed** 40 ft., fly 250 ft. (clumsy); climb stone  
**Melee** bite +37 (4d6+19/19–20), 2 claws +36 (2d8+13/19–20), tail slap +34 (2d8+19), 2 wings +34 (2d6+6)  
**Space** 20 ft.; **Reach** 15 ft. (20 ft. with bite)  
**Special Attacks** breath weapon (120-ft. line, DC 31, 24d6 acid), crush (4d6+19, DC 31), deadly joke (DC 26), mass laughter (DC 23), slow breath, tail sweep (2d6+19, DC 31)  
**Spell-Like Abilities** (CL 27th; concentration +34)  

At will— *[grease](../../magic/spells/grease.md)* (DC 18), *[hideous laughter](../../magic/spells/hideous-laughter.md)* (DC 19), *[move earth](../../magic/spells/move-earth.md)*, *[stone shape](../../magic/spells/stone-shape.md)*, *[transmute mud to rock](../../magic/spells/transmute-mud-to-rock.md)*, *[transmute rock to mud](../../magic/spells/transmute-rock-to-mud.md)*, *[wall of stone](../../magic/spells/wall-of-stone.md)*  

**Sorcerer Spells Known** (CL 19th; concentration +26)  

9th (4/day)— *[clashing rocks*](../../magic/spells/clashing-rocks.md)* (DC 26), *[weird* ](../../magic/spells/weird.md)(DC 27)  
8th (6/day)— *[irresistible dance](../../magic/spells/irresistible-dance.md)* (DC 25), *[scintillating pattern](../../magic/spells/scintillating-pattern.md)* (DC 26), *[temporal stasis](../../magic/spells/temporal-stasis.md)* (DC 25)  
7th (7/day)— *[mass hold person* ](../../magic/spells/hold-person-mass.md)(DC 24), *[reverse gravity](../../magic/spells/reverse-gravity.md)*, *[teleport object* ](../../magic/spells/teleport-object.md)(DC 24)  
6th (7/day)— *[antimagic field](../../magic/spells/antimagic-field.md)*, *[mislead](../../magic/spells/mislead.md)*, *[programmed image* ](../../magic/spells/programmed-image.md)(DC 24)  
5th (7/day)— *[mind fog](../../magic/spells/mind-fog.md)* (DC 22), *[polymorph](../../magic/spells/polymorph.md)*, *[sending](../../magic/spells/sending.md)*, *[teleport](../../magic/spells/teleport.md)*  
4th (7/day)— *[confusion](../../magic/spells/confusion.md)* (DC 21), *[rainbow pattern](../../magic/spells/rainbow-pattern.md)* (DC 22), *[stone shape](../../magic/spells/stone-shape.md)*, *[stoneskin](../../magic/spells/stoneskin.md)*  
3rd (8/day)— *[dispel magic](../../magic/spells/dispel-magic.md)*, *[haste](../../magic/spells/haste.md)*, *[suggestion* ](../../magic/spells/suggestion.md)(DC 20), *[tongues](../../magic/spells/tongues.md)*  
2nd (8/day)— *[glitterdust* ](../../magic/spells/glitterdust.md)(DC 19), *[invisibility](../../magic/spells/invisibility.md)*, *[phantom trap](../../magic/spells/phantom-trap.md)*, *[pyrotechnics](../../magic/spells/pyrotechnics.md)*, *[see invisibility](../../magic/spells/see-invisibility.md)*  
1st (8/day)— *[expeditious retreat](../../magic/spells/expeditious-retreat.md)*, *[magic aura](../../magic/spells/magic-aura.md)*, *[obscuring mist](../../magic/spells/obscuring-mist.md)*, *[shield](../../magic/spells/shield.md)*, *[silent image* ](../../magic/spells/silent-image.md)(DC 19)  
0 (at will)— *[dancing lights](../../magic/spells/dancing-lights.md)*, *[detect magic](../../magic/spells/detect-magic.md)*, *[ghost sound* ](../../magic/spells/ghost-sound.md)(DC 18), *[light](../../magic/spells/light.md)*, *[mage hand](../../magic/spells/mage-hand.md)*, *[message](../../magic/spells/message.md)*, *[open/close](../../magic/spells/open-close.md)*, *[prestidigitation](../../magic/spells/prestidigitation.md)*, *[read magic](../../magic/spells/read-magic.md)*  

* This spell is from the Pathfinder RPG Advanced Player’s Guide.  


**Statistics**


**Str** 37, **Dex** 8, **Con** 27, **Int** 24, **Wis** 25, **Cha** 24  
**Base Atk** +27; **CMB** +44 (+46 disarm, +48 trip); **CMD** 53 (55 vs. disarm, 59 vs. trip)  
**Feats** Combat Expertise, Greater Trip, Improved Critical (bite, claw), [Deft Maneuvers](../../rules/feats/deft-maneuvers.md), Improved Initiative, Improved Vital Strike, Lightning Reflexes, Multiattack, Quicken Spell, Spell Focus (Illusion), Vital Strike, [Weapon Focus (bite)](../../rules/feats/weapon-focus.md), [Toughness](../../rules/feats/toughness.md); [Power Attack](../../rules/feats/power-attack.md) (no feat needed)  
*House rules: Improved Disarm, Improved Trip are covered by Deft Maneuvers; Power Attack needs no feat; in their place: Weapon Focus (bite), Toughness.*  
**Skills** Bluff +37, Craft (traps) +47 (using improvised tools), Diplomacy +37, Disable Device +26, Fly +15, Knowledge (geography, history) +37, Perception +37 (+49 vs. traps), Perform (comedy) +34, Sense Motive +37, Spellcraft +37, Stealth +17, Use Magic Device +37  
**Languages** Common, Draconic, Dwarven, Elven, Giant, Gnome, Halfling, Terran  
**SQ** trap master  


**Special Abilities**


**Climb Stone (Ex)** A copper dragon can climb on stone surfaces as though using the *spider climb* spell.  

**Deadly Joke (Sp)** Once per day, as a standard action, a great wyrm copper dragon can tell a joke that kills. This affects one target, and functions as *power word kill*. This is a language-dependent sonic effect.  

**Mass Laughter (Sp)** An ancient copper dragon can tell a fantastic joke once per day as a standard action. All creatures within 10 feet per age category must make a Will save or laugh for 1 round per age category, as if affected by *hideous laughter*. The save DC is Charisma-based. This is equal to a 6th-level spell.  

**Slow Aura (Su)** An old or older copper dragon is surrounded by an aura of slowness. All creatures within 5 feet of the dragon must make a Will save or be affected as per *slow* for 1 round. An ancient dragon’s aura extends to 10 feet. For great wyrm copper dragons, those opponents that fail their saves are slowed for 1d4 rounds. The DC of this save is equal to the dragon’s breath weapon. A copper dragon can suppress or activate this aura at will as a free action.  

**Slow Breath (Su)** Instead of a line of acid, a copper dragon can breathe a cone of slowing gas. Those in the cone must make a Fortitude save or be slowed (as per the spell *slow*) for 1d6 rounds plus 1 round per age category of the dragon.  

**Trap Master (Ex)** A juvenile or older copper dragon receives a +1 bonus per age category on Craft (traps) and Perception checks made to locate a trap. Upon becoming a mature adult, he can also use Disable Device to disarm magic traps as if he had the rogue’s Trapfinding class feature.  



**Ecology**


**Environment** warm hills  
**Organization** solitary  
**Treasure** triple
